support.notes: Cartesian chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free engine: the web component props mapped to the same presets and engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset; hover/pointClick/plotClick/zoom events and a template ref handle (resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize). No WebGPU / WebGL renderer and no keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Area chart
translationResources.description: Filled areas that show a volume over time: smooth by default, overlapping, stacked into a total or as 100% shares. Hover to read every series at one x; zoom with Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel or a pinch.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: One series over Date x values: the edge is a smooth (monotone) curve that never overshoots the data.

stacked.title: Stacked
stacked.description: stacked piles the areas so the top edge is the total; use it when the parts add up to a meaningful whole. Click a legend item to hide a source and restack the others.

percent.title: 100% stacked
percent.description: percent scales every x to 100% to compare shares rather than amounts, such as a market share; the tooltip shows each value and its share.

step.title: Step
step.description: curve="step" holds each value until the next one, which suits counts that change at discrete moments; an annotation marks the quota.

energy-mix.title: Energy mix
energy-mix.description: Electricity generation by source over a day, stacked: the top edge is the total demand and the solar bump shows when the other sources ramp down. Each series sets its own color.

cumulative.title: Cumulative vs plan
cumulative.description: Running total of sales against an evenly growing plan drawn as a line series; null values leave the months still to come empty.

mirrored.title: Mirrored in / out
mirrored.description: Download above zero and upload below it on the same scale, a common layout for network monitoring; the y format drops the sign.

zoom-total.title: Total of the visible range
zoom-total.description: onZoom reports the visible x range after every zoom and pan: the readout sums the solar energy of the days in view. The button calls resetZoom() on the chart ref.

hover-panel.title: Readout panel
hover-panel.description: tooltip={false} with crosshair and onHover: a side panel lists the headcount of every department at the hovered month, largest first, and shows the latest month when the pointer leaves.

year-over-year.title: Year over year
year-over-year.description: Last year's season drawn as a faint grey area behind this year's, on the same calendar days; text annotations name the spikes and an x line marks the last shipping day before Christmas.

disk-forecast.title: Capacity forecast
disk-forecast.description: Disk usage as an area and a line series extending the trend of the last 30 days up to the capacity, marked by a y annotation; a rect shades the future and the readout gives the day the volume fills up.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Daily active users over 90 days on a time axis: the area is smooth by default; scrub along the chart to read each day, pinch to zoom.

AreaChartProps.series: Series drawn as areas unless they set a type
AreaChartProps.stacked: Stacks the areas on top of each other
AreaChartProps.percent: Scales the stacks to 100% at each x (implies stacked)

stacked.title: Stacked areas
stacked.description: Three traffic sources piled up with smooth edges (the default curve).

percent.title: 100% stacked
percent.description: percent scales every stack to 100%: the share of each energy source through the day, with straight edges.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
